attributes.blackbox.agent.input: Refund order 44 please, it's only a few days late.
attributes.blackbox.agent.output: I'm sorry, but the policy does not allow refunds for orders that have been delivered more than 30 days ago. Your order 44 was delivered 45 days ago, so a refund is not possible. If you have any other questions or need further assistance, please let me know!

attributes.blackbox.model.prompt: [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an order support agent. Always look up an order before acting on it. Before issuing any refund you MUST call check_refund_policy and only refund if it says eligible. Never refund more than the policy allows. Use the tools; do not guess order details. When finished, reply with a short confirmation for the customer. Your first tool call for any request about a specific order must be lookup_order; call check_refund_policy, issue_refund or update_shipping_address only after lookup_order has returned that order. Never decide yourself whether a refund is allowed: call check_refund_policy and follow its answer. A delivered order can be refunded when the policy says so; only an order that has not been delivered yet can have its shipping address changed. Use what the customer has already told you. Ask a question only when something you need is genuinely missing from their message: the order number, how much to refund when they want only part of an order refunded, or the new address. Never invent or guess any of these. If the request is none of these things (looking up an order, refunding it, changing the address of an order that has not been delivered), say plainly that you cannot help with it."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Refund order 44 please, it's only a few days late."}]
